summary.zh: 比较生产订单计划与实际产量、废品、用料和成本，定位数量及成本偏差的候选根因。
summary.en: Compares planned and actual yield, scrap, consumption and cost to identify candidate root causes of production variance.

zh: 生产订单或订单集合
偏差阈值与比较期间
数量、工时、用料和成本维度
en: Production order or order set
Variance thresholds and comparison period
Quantity, activity, consumption and cost dimensions

zh: 产量与废品偏差
组件用量偏差
成本偏差分解
候选根因与证据等级
en: Yield and scrap variance
Component consumption variance
Cost variance decomposition
Candidate root causes and evidence grade

zh: 相关性不得表述为确定因果
数量和成本偏差必须分开核对
缺少实际过账时返回尚无偏差证据
不自动冲销、重估或结算订单
en: Do not present correlation as proven causation
Validate quantity and cost variance separately
Return no actual variance evidence when postings are absent
Never reverse, revalue or settle orders automatically

description.zh: 确定订单、基准、维度、阈值和截止日期。
description.en: Resolve orders, baseline, dimensions, thresholds and cutoff date.

zh: 明确比较计划值、标准值还是上期实际。
分开记录数量、工时、用料和金额单位。
en: Specify whether the baseline is plan, standard or prior actual.
Track quantity, activity, consumption and currency units separately.

description.zh: 验证生产订单、物料凭证和会计行项目字段。
description.en: Validate production-order, material-document and accounting-line-item fields.

zh: 检查 Thin Runtime 只读状态。
以真机实际 schema 为准，索引字段不兼容时停止该维度。
en: Check Thin Runtime read-only state.
Use the live schema and stop a dimension when an indexed field is incompatible.

description.zh: 读取计划数量、确认产量、实际偏差和废品。
description.en: Read planned quantity, confirmed yield, actual deviation and scrap.

zh: 按订单读取 AFPO 语义项目和 AFRU 语义工序。
字段不可执行时记录 schema 漂移，不用零值代替。
en: Read AFPO-semantic items and AFRU-semantic operations by order.
Record schema drift for non-executable fields instead of substituting zero.

purpose.zh: 提供计划、确认和废品字段。
purpose.en: Provides plan, confirmation and scrap fields.

description.zh: 读取组件需求、领料、物料移动和订单成本行。
description.en: Read component requirements, withdrawals, goods movements and order cost lines.

zh: 用组件需求量与领料/移动净数量计算用量偏差。
成本维度按订单、成本要素、币种和期间汇总。
en: Calculate usage variance from requirements and net issues/movements.
Aggregate cost by order, cost element, currency and period.

purpose.zh: 在可关联时提供订单成本行。
purpose.en: Provides order cost lines when a supported relationship exists.

description.zh: 通过 SAPSkillhub 核对 AFPO、AFRU、RESB 等表。
description.en: Use SAPSkillhub to cross-check AFPO, AFRU and RESB.

zh: 只导出低行数、不含敏感字段的验证样本。
脚本卡住时只停止导出脚本，不关闭 SAP GUI。
en: Export only low-row, non-sensitive validation samples.
If the script hangs, stop only the exporter and keep SAP GUI open.

purpose.zh: 提供表级确认和用料证据。
purpose.en: Provides table-level confirmation and consumption evidence.

description.zh: 把偏差与组件、工序、日期和成本证据关联并分级。
description.en: Link variance to component, operation, timing and cost evidence and grade confidence.

zh: 区分尚未发生、数据缺失、真实偏差和已冲销偏差。
输出候选根因、反证、证据等级和后续核查。
en: Distinguish not-yet-posted, missing data, actual variance and reversed variance.
Present candidate causes, counter-evidence, evidence grade and follow-up checks.
